description: Synthetic deterministic safety corpus for Draft from text (ADR-0092), English and Russian. Each case supplies an explicit model answer (claims) and is run through the production wire validation, groundMealDraft and the public response contract; no model is called. expect.nutrition gives, per field, the exact value that must be proposed (a positive control) or "not_proposed" (the claimed value must never be accepted). expect.outcome other than "draft" means the whole answer must be refused. Frozen before the first run; a change is a new version in a new file.
